description: A person's own statement, in their own account, of their ORCID iD: 'my ORCID is X' (typed on the IOSP room's dashboard; added 2026-10-03). It is what lets RRGI find a person's papers by their ORCID and match an attribution naming that ORCID to the person, so they can confirm it. Typed, never verified: RRGI does not check the ORCID with ORCID's sign-in, so it is the person's claim, not proof. The latest record per account wins. It is not a graph node: views never return it; it is read by the person API. An RRGI extension (MIRA has no person records).

orcid.description: The ORCID iD, bare: 0000-0000-0000-000X (RRGI's validator checks the form: four groups of four digits, the last character a digit or X; a lower-case x is accepted and read as X).

name.description: Optional: the name the person goes by in the field.
